about.title: About Us & Our Founding Story
about.intro: MedGift LLC was founded to make healthcare and medical solutions easier to access—with transparent, fast, and secure service.
manifesto.title: THE MEDGIFT MANIFESTO: Reuse, Empower, Heal the Planet
manifesto.subtitle: A clear promise for donors, recipients, and partners who believe medical care and planetary care belong together.
manifesto.lead: Every year, thousands of fully functional medical devices are left unused in storage, while millions of individuals with disabilities lack access to essential mobility equipment. MedGift US bridges this gap by turning unused medical items into life-changing mobility solutions.
manifesto.pillar1Body: Every year, thousands of fully functional medical devices gather dust in storage while millions lack basic mobility. We end this cycle of waste by reclaiming usable equipment and connecting it directly with those in need—stopping overconsumption at its root.
manifesto.pillar2Body: A global, transparent solidarity network built by and for the disability community. We break down financial barriers and offer dignified, peer-to-peer access to mobility tools, ensuring no one is left behind.
manifesto.pillar3Body: Medical equipment recycling is clean energy in action. By extending the lifecycle of existing items, we cut factory emissions, reduce electronic and plastic waste, and track real-time CO2 savings on our live ESG dashboard.
manifesto.ctaBody: Join us in turning idle equipment into freedom, dignity, and a greener planet.
manifesto.detail1Body: The world turns every day in a frenzy of overconsumption. On one side, hundreds of thousands of life-saving medical devices left to gather dust in storage—still working like new. On the other, millions of people with disabilities forced to stay home because they cannot access a single wheelchair, walker, or care supply. We are here to stop this injustice. MedGift US pulls every working idle medical item out of landfills and warehouses and connects it directly with those who need it. We end waste and turn reuse into a way of life.
manifesto.detail2Intro: This is not just a charity project; it is a global solidarity network built among people with disabilities and their families.
manifesto.detail2Bullet1: A Community That Turns Recipients Into Leaders: The person in need is no longer a passive recipient, but an actor at the center of this solidarity.
manifesto.detail2Bullet2: Fearless and Free Movement: Sharing a single device means someone can go to school, join work, go outside, and breathe freely.
manifesto.detail2Bullet3: Safe and Dignified Access: Without middlemen, with transparency, 48-hour fair reservation, and secure communication, everyone reaches what they need with the respect they deserve.
manifesto.detail3Intro: Every newly manufactured medical device means tons of carbon emissions, factory smoke, and plastic/metal waste left in nature. MedGift US treats medical recycling as the cleanest form of energy!
manifesto.detail3Bullet1: Zero Out the Carbon Footprint: By putting existing working devices back into circulation, we reduce the need for new production and factory emissions.
manifesto.detail3Bullet2: Live ESG Metrics: We account for every device returned to beneficial use and every kilogram of CO₂ emissions prevented—with our live counters.

aiSupport.title: MeGi
aiSupport.welcome: Hi there, I’m MeGi 💙 your little MedGift helper. Whether you’re giving a device a second life or looking for something you need, I’m right here with you. Ask me anything — donations, requests, 48-hour reservations, QR handoffs, passwords, HIPAA, the NGO portal. And if you’d rather reach a human, write to info@medgift.us; we read every single message.
aiSupport.reply.request: Of course — I’m right here with you. To request equipment: open Recipient, browse or search, tap a listing for distance & sizing, then Reserve. Nothing fits? Add to Wishlist so Instant Match can ping you when something similar is listed. After reserving you have 48 hours to arrange pickup/meetup and confirm with the QR/handoff flow. Want me to walk you through filters or the wishlist next?
aiSupport.reply.donate: Donating is simple and it matters. Go to DME or Wound Care, fill condition, ZIP, sizing (DME), and handoff (pickup / assistance / meetup), accept the waiver if shown, then submit. You’ll get a printable QR donation label for secure delivery confirmation — and your impact shows on the ESG dashboard. If FDA/safety or expiry rules block a listing, tell me the message and I’ll explain what to change.
aiSupport.reply.reservation: The 48-hour reservation rule keeps things fair. When you reserve, that item is held just for you for 48 hours so you can arrange pickup or meetup and confirm receipt. If the hold expires without confirmation, it goes back to the open list. See “already reserved”? Someone else got there first — wishlist it or keep browsing. Need help confirming delivery before the clock runs out? Ask me.
aiSupport.reply.shipping: Handoff depends on what the donor chose. Listings show Pickup Only, Assistance Available, or Meetup Possible — check the badge on the card or detail page. After you reserve, coordinate safely in Secure Chat (don’t paste private phone/email if the app redacts it). Many donors can help load gear or meet halfway. Tell me which badge you see and I’ll suggest the smoothest next step.
aiSupport.reply.esg: Every reuse helps. The Impact & ESG dashboard on Home (and Profile) tracks equipment saved, estimated CO₂ avoided (kg), and community savings ($). Numbers update as donations and confirmed handoffs grow — they’re live, not static marketing. Curious what a metric means? Ask me which number you’re looking at.
aiSupport.reply.complaint: I’m sorry this felt rough — that matters. Tell me what broke (login, reserve, QR, email, listing…) and what the screen said. I’ll give you the fix path. For sponsorship/support that needs a human inbox, use Partner with Us / Contact Us — your message goes to the admin team. I’m MeGi; I stay with you until we unstick this.
aiSupport.reply.navigate: Happy to orient you. Main spots: Home (impact + shortcuts), DME / Wound Care (donate), Recipient (browse & reserve), AI Scan, Requests, Urgent Wishlist, Exchange, My Items (Pass-It-On), NGO Portal, Profile (wishlist, receipts, alerts). Say the goal in plain words — “I need a wheelchair near 90210” or “reset my password” — and I’ll send you to the right place.
aiSupport.reply.fallback: I’m MeGi — still with you. I can help with login/signup/password, donating (DME & wound care), requesting & 48-hour reserves, QR handoffs, wishlist/Instant Match, Pass-It-On, exchange receipts, AI Scan, NGO portal, HIPAA, emergency mode, languages, and ESG impact. Try a chip below, or just describe the result you’re seeing in the app.

hipaa.pageIntro: This Notice of Privacy Practices describes how MedGift US may use and disclose protected health information (PHI) you submit through the platform, and how you can exercise your privacy rights.
hipaa.sectionUsesTitle: How we use and disclose PHI
hipaa.sectionUsesBody: We use PHI only to verify eligibility for medical-equipment matching, support NGO partners you authorize, improve safety of donations, and comply with law. We do not sell PHI.
hipaa.sectionRightsBody: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of PHI we hold about you, and you may withdraw consent for future collections where permitted by law. Contact privacy@medgift.us to exercise these rights.
hipaa.sectionSecurityBody: PHI at rest is encrypted with AES-256. Data in transit uses HTTPS/TLS. Access is role-based. Sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity. Access to health records is audited.
hipaa.sectionContactBody: Privacy inquiries: privacy@medgift.us or info@medgift.us. MedGift LLC.
hipaa.modalIntro: Before submitting health information, please review how MedGift US protects PHI.
hipaa.modalSummary: By continuing you acknowledge encrypted storage, limited role-based access, audit logging, and your rights under our Notice of Privacy Practices.

privacy.pageBody: MedGift US collects account details and, when you choose to submit them, health-related documents needed to match medical equipment. We encrypt sensitive data at rest, transmit data over HTTPS, limit access by role, expire idle sessions after 15 minutes, and keep consent and audit logs. We do not sell personal information. See the Notice of Privacy Practices for PHI-specific rights.
aiSupport.subtitle: MedGift guide · here for every step
aiSupport.chip.qr: How does the QR label work?
aiSupport.reply.greeting: Hi! MeGi here 👋 What are you trying to do in MedGift right now — donate, find equipment, fix a login, or something else? I’m with you.
aiSupport.reply.thanks: You’re welcome — that’s what I’m here for. If anything else pops up (reservation, QR, wishlist, password…), just type it. I’ve got you.
aiSupport.reply.login: Let’s get you back in. Tap Log In, use the email you registered with, and your password. If you see “wrong password,” try Forgot Password — you’ll get a reset link by email. If you were idle ~15 minutes, MedGift signs you out for privacy (HIPAA) — just log in again and you’ll be fine. Stuck on a specific error text? Paste it here.
aiSupport.reply.signup: Creating an account is quick. From the welcome screen tap Sign Up, choose your role — Donor (give equipment), Recipient (request & reserve), or NGO (partner portal) — then complete your profile. Recipients may need ID/doctor docs; NGOs need org/EIN details. You’ll also check the HIPAA consent box to finish. Tell me which role you’re picking and I’ll guide the exact taps.
aiSupport.reply.password: Password reset, step by step: open Forgot Password → enter your registered email → check inbox (and spam) for the MedGift reset link → open it and set a new password (follow the length rules on that screen). No email? That usually means the address isn’t registered yet — try Sign Up, or double-check the spelling. Still stuck? Tell me what the screen says after you submit.
aiSupport.reply.qr: The QR label is how MedGift locks in a safe handoff. Donors print/save the QR after listing (also under My Items). At delivery, the recipient scans the MedGift QR (or completes the received & inspected sign-off) so the reservation isn’t stuck. Wrong/non-MedGift codes won’t confirm. Can’t download the PDF? Try again from My Items / item detail — or tell me the exact error.
aiSupport.reply.wishlist: Wishlist + Instant Match = your safety net. On a listing (or Recipient), tap Add to Wishlist. Turn Instant Match alerts on in Profile so you’re notified when a similar donation appears — then reserve within 48 hours. Urgent needs live under Urgent Wishlist. Duplicate entry or missing alert? Check the match-alerts toggle and that your wishlist item has the features you need.
aiSupport.reply.passItOn: Pass-It-On keeps equipment circulating. Open My Items: you’ll see what you donated and what you received. When you’re done with a received item, Pass it on to re-list it for someone else — same care as a new donation. Empty “received”? You may not have completed a QR/handoff confirmation yet. Tell me which section looks wrong and I’ll untangle it.
aiSupport.reply.exchange: Exchange is for swapping/confirming equipment between parties and pulling tax-style receipts afterward. Open Exchange from the nav, complete the swap steps, then check Profile → receipts / exchange receipts for the PDF. If a swap won’t finish or the receipt won’t download, describe the last screen you saw — I’ll point to the fix.
aiSupport.reply.aiScan: AI Scan helps identify equipment before you donate. Open AI Scan, upload or capture a clear photo, and use the result to fill your DME/Wound Care listing faster. Blurry photos or odd angles can mis-identify — try better light and a full-item shot. Want the result to become a listing? I’ll tell you exactly which fields to copy over.
aiSupport.reply.ngo: NGO partners use the NGO Portal (nav). You’ll need the NGO role and org verification (EIN / docs) for the verified badge. From there you can submit bulk equipment needs and track requests. Not an NGO account? Switch/create with the NGO role at Sign Up, or use Partner with Us on the landing page to contact us. What are you trying to submit?
aiSupport.reply.profile: Profile is your hub: edit address/photo, wishlist, receipts, Instant Match alerts, impact cards, and privacy links. Wrong ZIP from autocomplete? Edit Profile and set city/ZIP carefully. Empty donation stats usually means no completed listings/handoffs yet. Photo upload failing? Try a smaller image and retry — then tell me if an error banner appears.
aiSupport.reply.hipaa: MedGift takes privacy seriously. On Sign Up / profile edit you’ll check the HIPAA consent box (Notice of Privacy Practices + Privacy Policy). You can read the full notices anytime under HIPAA Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy. Without consent, signup can’t finish — that’s intentional for PHI protection. Idle sessions time out so health-related screens stay locked. Questions about what we collect? Ask me specifically.
aiSupport.reply.emergency: Disaster & Emergency mode highlights crisis-priority needs. When it’s on, you’ll see the red banner and Disaster Relief Hub options for donors/recipients. If you expected urgent disaster matching but don’t see it, the mode may be off (Profile toggle / site setting) or listings may not be tagged for relief. Tell me whether you’re donating or requesting in a crisis and I’ll route you.
aiSupport.reply.language: You can switch language anytime with the language menu in the app bar (Home, welcome, onboarding). We support English, Spanish, Turkish, Chinese, Russian, Arabic, Uyghur, French, and German. Pick your language — the UI updates for that session/preference. RTL layouts (Arabic/Uyghur) should flip automatically. Still seeing the wrong language? Tell me which one you selected.

story.title: About Us & Our Founding Story
story.whoTitle: Who We Are and Why We Started
story.whoBody1: MedGift LLC was founded to make access to healthcare and medical solutions easier—and to bring trusted service standards together with the speed of the digital world. As a U.S.-based company, we set out with one core purpose: help people reach their healthcare and medical needs in the most transparent, fast, and secure way.
story.whoBody2: We launched the MedGift.us platform with a vision to remove complex processes, access barriers, and trust gaps in healthcare. By integrating technology with legal requirements, high data-security standards (HIPAA), and a user-first service mindset, we aim to make a real difference in the industry.
story.missionBody: To make life easier for our users by delivering an innovative, accessible, and fully secure digital infrastructure in medical and healthcare services.
story.visionBody: Starting from the U.S. market, to become one of the first, most trusted, and most ethical platforms people think of worldwide for health technology and medical services.
disaster.announcementHeadline: Regarding the Earthquake Disaster in Colombia
disaster.announcementP1: We have learned with deep sorrow of the earthquake disaster in Colombia. In this difficult time, we extend our sincere condolences to all communities affected by the earthquake and to the people of Colombia; we offer our condolences to the families of those who lost their lives and wish a swift recovery to the injured.
disaster.announcementP2: As MedGift LLC, we recognize that medical infrastructure and healthcare support are vital in humanitarian response. Accordingly, we stand ready to act in solidarity with all medical aid organizations, civil society groups, and international partners conducting field operations or coordinating relief in the region.
disaster.announcementP3: To enable rapid, effective, and coordinated action in health and medical support, we urgently request that all relevant institutions and companies active in the region contact us. We see joining forces to help heal these wounds as both a humanitarian and corporate responsibility.
disaster.announcementP4: Please contact us directly for collaboration and coordination requests.
